reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest development update on the mechanics of unit movement in Provincia! In our upcoming update, soldiers will no longer teleport during formation changes. Instead, they will slide into position, maintaining their ranks as they move. This means more realistic and strategic gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: New Update: Ranks That Turn and March
steam.body: We're excited to announce a new update for Provincia that changes how units move during battle. Soldiers will now slide into formation, eliminating teleportation and enhancing the strategic depth of gameplay. For more details on these changes, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
